host.measurement_method: PowerShell Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem (FreePhysicalMemory, TotalVisibleMemorySize) and Get-PSDrive C, 2026-11-24

limits.output_estimation_method: G0 plan value (768 MiB host reserve, one job, 4 GiB stop threshold, 64 MiB cap) based on the existing 183,472-byte directed VCD with margin; to be replaced by the measured output of the first bounded pilot run (see runs/ after approval)
limits.decision_record: 2026-11-24, Nguyen Quan: per-run output cap 512 MiB (builds are temporary and outside the repository; retained output is flat logs); free-disk stop threshold lowered from 4 GiB to 2 GiB because the host volume had only 2-4 GiB free for reasons outside the project. Residual risk: a full disk during a run can corrupt that run; dvp_regress.py checks the threshold plus a 600 MiB working set before every build and case configuration.

waveform_policy.planned_signal_scope: none by default; targeted VCD of dut ports plus dvp checker events for a failing run (gated first pixel, FIFO push/read, timeout terminal cycle, reset and flush windows)
waveform_policy.planned_time_windows: failure window of 2 us around the first checker error, captured in a new run with the same configuration and seed

compression.method: none planned; lossless zip with SHA-256 round trip only if a later reviewed need appears

review.record: Approved with the per-run output cap raised to 512 MiB (536870912 bytes). RAM budget 1 GiB, one concurrent job and the 4 GiB free-disk stop threshold are unchanged.

measurement: Per-run peak RAM, disk and durations of the final regression are in sim/final/resource_usage.json and sim/final/commands.json.
